scope: Raw-input estimate for two servings using the AFCD 70.8% raw edible fraction for untrimmed bone-in lamb cutlets. All edible lamb, added butter, drippings and resting juices are served and eaten. Raw edible fraction and composition are table estimates; there is no measured cook yield.

ingredients.matchEvidence: AFCD F004923 describes raw bone-in lamb cutlets with attached internal and external fat. The recipe calls for untrimmed rib cutlets cut from a rack and weighed with bones. AFCD values describe this cut category, not an individually tested batch or branded product.
ingredients.edibleEvidence: AFCD Release 3 Food Details, F004923 (https://www.foodstandards.gov.au/science-data/food-nutrient-databases/afcd/data-files): analysed portion 70.8% (54.8% lean meat, 11.7% internal fat, 4.3% external fat); 29.2% bone/gristle. The factor is for raw purchase weight and does not describe cooked yield.
ingredients.retentionEvidence: All edible lamb, attached fat, butter, rendered pan fat and meat juices are served equally and assumed eaten. The bone and gristle are inedible.
